counter_definition: Number of rows in state CLEAN, not all nonmandatory/retained victims; WB_COMPLETE excluded.

concrete_pairs: CLEAN replacement performs decrement and increment inside one commit; joint net0 is a hardware design choice, not modeled two port grants.

Missing-sector reclaim in tvd_frontend then ordinary ft_access in same cache_cycle can cause another count event if victim retention/landing reclaim occurs. Static code permits conditions; reachability/frequency unmeasured.
Lower acceptance/completion and response metadata may share cache cycle with frontend even though they do not alter clean_count; they still compete for row read/write ports.
cycle_competition.conservative_count_event_envelope: Frontend missing-sector erase(-1), optional dynamic landing reclaim(-1), victim install(old CLEAN -1,new CLEAN +1). This is a source-site envelope, NOT a proved simultaneously reachable maximum: landing reclaim creates EMPTY so later install generally consumes EMPTY; CLEAN replacement net0 can be fused.
cycle_competition.normal_path: One frontend head, but no rule that restricts all directory mutators to one call per cycle. TVD frontend missing-sector reclaim can fall through into ft_access; dynamic landing reclaim and later install/promotion can also mutate metadata at same physical_cycle.
cycle_competition.reported_existing_metadata_lanes: tvd_print emits indexed_control_read_views=3 and update_lanes=3 as descriptive contract; no quota-specific arbiter/credit binding proves spare capacity.

modeled.existing_lookup: one extra serialized lookup cycle and one frontend query/cycle; cached ticket avoids hidden repeat CAM lookup
modeled.existing_payload: four banks/P1 + bank grant and response/lower waits retained
modeled.existing_scans: Replacement selection, occupancy/stat and advance loops remain software scans; no claim of zero existing selection cost.

rows.latency: No quota-specific cycle, port reservation or backpressure
rows.ordering: Read count >= limit after cap0 refusal; then select EMPTY or unpinned CLEAN reclaim candidate

rows.delta: CLEAN->CLEAN 0 via -- then ++; other->CLEAN +1; CLEAN->WB_STAGED -1; other->WB_STAGED 0
rows.latency: Synchronous at caller now; no counter lane scheduler
rows.ordering: Reject stale revision/invalid input before mutation; advance old occupancy; bump incarnation; decrement old CLEAN; change row state; increment new CLEAN; assert <=limit; update payload/age; revision++

rows.delta: -1 only when source CLEAN, 0 for WB_COMPLETE
rows.latency: No quota-specific cycles; retains existing tag/payload/WB readiness
rows.ordering: Ticket incarnation, mandatory WB and reader guards; dirty plan additionally revision guard; pre-reserve resources; same handle transfer; source row erased or reused WB_STAGED; generation bumps
Live incarnation and no mandatoryWB/readers; decrement before erase; bump row incarnation; clear payload; revision++

rows.latency: Existing WB/data-transfer/generation checks; no added quota cycle
rows.ordering: WB_STAGED->WB_INFLIGHT->WB_COMPLETE; completion with no payload erases non-CLEAN; retained WB_COMPLETE remains outside clean count

rows.latency: Existing bank and response backpressure modeled, not quota-count cost
rows.ordering: Reader pin/lease + revision protect lifetime; response requires real bank service and enqueue

rows.counter_write: up to128 decrements across while loop
rows.latency: Software drain loop has no per-row/update modeled cycle; do not use as normal-cycle one-port proof
rows.ordering: Requires epoch_ready and no outstanding lease; allocator release each handle; same now allowed repeatedly

storage.software_declaration: unsigned m_capacity, m_clean_limit, m_clean_count; no bitpacked RTL inferred
